subject: English
passage: Metals give tools and weapons their strength and durability. Bronze is an alloy made from copper and tin that was widely used in ancient metalworking. Bronze tools contain significant amounts of copper, which gives them their characteristic properties. Metals can also be iron-based; iron-based tools contain high levels of iron and very low copper content. In a 2023 study, archaeologists tested metal fragments from tools made by the Hallstatt culture approximately 2,800 years ago. The analysis showed that the metal fragments from several tools contained very little copper but had high levels of iron. This finding led the researchers to conclude that ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: the Hallstatt tools examined in the study are the earliest surviving examples of the use of iron-based metals for making tools.
choices.B: the Hallstatt toolmakers preferred to use iron-based metals because they are much stronger than copper-based alloys are.
choices.C: the metals used by the Hallstatt toolmakers likely came from iron ore because copper was difficult to obtain.
choices.D: the Hallstatt toolmakers used iron-based metals rather than bronze to create some of the tools examined in the study.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer because it presents the conclusion that most logically follows from the text's discussion of the chemical composition of different metals. The text begins by differentiating between two kinds of metals: bronze alloys, which contain significant amounts of copper, and iron-based metals, which have high levels of iron and very low copper content. The text then goes on to describe an analysis by archaeologists of metal fragments from tools made by members of the Hallstatt culture around 2,800 years ago. The archaeologists found that the metal fragments from some tools contained very little copper but had high levels of iron. Since bronze contains significant amounts of copper, while iron-based metals have high iron levels and low copper content, the researchers concluded that the Hallstatt toolmakers used iron-based metals to create some of the tools examined in the study.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the text does not compare the strength of iron-based metals and copper-based alloys.
